slot-ff18ccf6-7489-4931-81d1-f21dc29c271.quote_span: California Governor Gavin Newsom has signed into law first-of-its-kind state legislation setting rules for how lawyers are permitted to use generative AI in their work.
slot-ff18ccf6-7489-4931-81d1-f21dc29c271.speaker: Reuters

slot-b73181ab-20f6-4592-b923-662639e6b97.quote_span: Newsom signed the bill, SB 574, on Wednesday alongside a slate of other AI-related measures that he said are intended to protect workers, empower doctors and prevent fraudsters online.

evidence.title: California sets guardrails on lawyers' AI use

occurrences.checkable_against: Court sanctions, warnings and filings involving AI-generated material
occurrences.quote_span: Courts across the country have imposed sanctions and issued warnings to lawyers who failed to vet AI-generated material and included “hallucinated” material in filings.
occurrences.speaker: Reuters
occurrences.subject: California SB 574

occurrences.checkable_against: Jeff Fisher's emailed statement to Reuters
occurrences.quote_span: Jeff Fisher, a San Francisco-based trial lawyer at Farella Braun + Martel, said in an email that the California legislation underscores the need for lawyers to verify outputs and avoid entering confidential information in public generative AI systems.
occurrences.speaker: Jeff Fisher
occurrences.subject: California SB 574

occurrences.checkable_against: Ariel House's emailed statement to Reuters
occurrences.quote_span: Cite-checking court filings is frequently done by paralegals under a lawyer’s supervision, House said in an email.

occurrences.subject: California SB 574

occurrences.quote_span: California Governor Gavin Newsom has signed into law first-of-its-kind state legislation setting rules for how lawyers are permitted to use generative AI in their work.

occurrences.checkable_against: Daren Orzechowski's emailed statement to Reuters
occurrences.quote_span: “The legislation overlaps with existing legal ethics rules but serves as a reminder that lawyers need to be checking and verifying the output received from AI tools,” Daren Orzechowski, a Silicon Valley-based M&A and technology transactions partner at A&O Shearman, said in an email.
occurrences.speaker: Daren Orzechowski
occurrences.subject: California SB 574

occurrences.checkable_against: California Rules of Court and California civil litigation rules
occurrences.quote_span: The law builds on requirements that already bind lawyers under state rules governing civil litigation, such as the need for court filings to be supported by existing law.
occurrences.speaker: Reuters
occurrences.subject: California SB 574

occurrences.checkable_against: Ariel House's statement to Reuters and law-firm staffing records
occurrences.quote_span: The requirement could be a heavy burden for solo practitioners and small law firms, while larger firms might be able to assign the task to a junior lawyer with a lower billing rate, she said.
occurrences.speaker: Ariel House
occurrences.subject: California SB 574

occurrences.checkable_against: State legislative enactment records concerning lawyers' and arbitrators' generative AI use
occurrences.quote_span: No other state has enacted a law targeted at lawyers' and arbitrators' use of the technology, though some attorneys have said the measure is partly duplicative of existing rules.
occurrences.speaker: Reuters
occurrences.subject: California SB 574

occurrences.checkable_against: Text of California SB 574
occurrences.quote_span: Lawyers also must take “reasonable steps” to verify AI outputs, correct any false or hallucinated output in any AI-generated material they use, and disclose the use of AI for documents submitted in court.
occurrences.speaker: Reuters
occurrences.subject: California SB 574

occurrences.checkable_against: Text of California SB 574
occurrences.quote_span: A lawyer responsible for submitting a filing in court must personally verify citations, including those provided by AI.
occurrences.speaker: Reuters
occurrences.subject: California SB 574

occurrences.checkable_against: Ariel House's statement to Reuters and California SB 574 implementation
occurrences.quote_span: That new verification requirement likely won’t curb lawyers’ use of AI, but could “dramatically expand the amount of time that the signing attorney would be required to spend reviewing the legal and evidentiary citations in each filing,” said Ariel House, a litigation partner in Baker Botts' San Francisco office.
occurrences.speaker: Ariel House
occurrences.subject: California SB 574

occurrences.checkable_against: Jeff Fisher's emailed statement to Reuters
occurrences.quote_span: “That said, I do not see the law as a sea change in the way lawyers and law firms are continuing to expand their use of AI," Fisher wrote. "The benefits and efficiencies are too great to ignore.”
occurrences.speaker: Jeff Fisher
occurrences.subject: California SB 574

occurrences.checkable_against: Text of California SB 574
occurrences.quote_span: Under the new measure, an attorney cannot “delegate the practice of law” to generative AI.
occurrences.speaker: Reuters
occurrences.subject: California SB 574

occurrences.checkable_against: Text of California SB 574
occurrences.quote_span: Arbitrators are restricted from delegating any decision-making to an AI tool.
